items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-05-10
items.q: I believe old man Dominguez, the bass player, was in that band.

ctx.x: The old man. The old man. They come from Mombardo first there somewhere. Yeah. Well, Deconjay and, let me see who else was in that band. Deconjay. I believe old man Dominguez, the bass player, was in that band. Paul Dominguez daddy. He's a bass violin and a bass player, too. He was one of the best bands in the city. DeRooks was in that, too. Old man DeRooks. The boy's father. Old man DeRooks. He was a great company player. I don't know the boys. What are their names? I don't know them boys. They play music? They…
